title: Generational language landscape
scope: Amended custom combination for the initial region's sociolinguistic configuration: older-generation parallel bilingualism in both parent tongues, younger-generation in-progress hybridising speech that is not a settled or named third language, an imperial-script literacy anchor with the original tongue customarily unwritten, the outlet settlement's imperial-monolingual default, and interpreter-capable competence as personal reputation only; all linguistic content, culture-frame content, rite and exchange language, institutions, demography, and natural System behaviour remain open or unchanged.
approval_evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author accepted WLD-CULTURE-007 through explicit multiple-choice selections, choosing an amended custom combination rather than any single displayed card — the drafted Option C parallel bilingualism for the older generation, amended to drop its remembered original-tongue script tradition, combined with an emerging Option-B-like hybridising development among the young that is explicitly in progress and is not a settled or named third language — together with the proposal's option-independent shared claim set.
question: Which qualitative sociolinguistic configuration governs the initial region — which speech varieties exist, their social domains and generational distribution, where literacy and the record function sit, and the outlet settlement's speech position — without fixing any word, name, sound, grammar feature, letterform, orthography, or sample utterance; without naming any variety; without settling culture-frame content, rite language, inscription, compact term, oath text, office, school, archive, or record content; without the outlet's internal composition beyond its speech default; and without any language fact for returning non-human peoples?
selection: Use an amended custom combination of the displayed options: the landscape is generationally split. (1) The older generation lives in the drafted Option C parallel bilingualism — both parent tongues stand side by side as full daily languages, keyed to strand and situation, with practiced code-switching as ordinary adult competence. (2) The younger generation, raised with both from childhood, is actively hybridising in an emerging Option-B-like development, using the two together and mixing words from both tongues within a single sentence. (3) That hybridising speech is an in-progress generational development, not a settled or named third language; how far it will carry, whether it stabilises, and whether the parent tongues recede are explicitly open and argued within the fiction. (4) Neither parent tongue is dying as fact, and no strand owns either tongue. (5) Literacy is anchored to the imperial script tradition for the record function — a living skill descended from imperial practice, not from any intact archive, with WLD-LOCATION-004's ceiling standing — and the original tongue is customarily unwritten; Option C's remembered original-tongue script tradition is the amendment and is not established. (6) The outlet settlement is imperial-monolingual by default, so cross-lake dealings lean on hillfort speakers. (7) Recognised interpreter-capable individuals exist as personal competence and reputation only — never an office, never part of adjudication, creating no procedure, standing, entitlement, or right to be heard. The proposal's option-independent shared claim set is promoted as displayed.
alternatives: A — HIGH-AND-HOME DIGLOSSIA: two varieties stacked by domain, the imperial tongue as the high register of record-keeping, formal adjudication and testimony occasions, and outward dealings, the original tongue as home-and-field speech, the division a leaky customary tendency policed by no rule or office, with prestige running in two contested currents. Not selected. Its literacy anchoring — imperial script tradition for the record function, original tongue customarily unwritten — matches the accepted amendment, and its oath and record texture remains option-local illustrative material binding nothing.

B — CONTACT VERNACULAR: three varieties generationally layered, a mixed daily speech already emerged within one settlement generation as the ordinary talk of walls, fields, and crews, with the walls-born generation strongest in it and the parent tongues receding toward elders, memory-keeping, records, and formal occasions. Not selected as displayed. Its generational-mixing element contributes the younger-generation development of the accepted combination, but only as an in-progress development; the settled vernacular, its status as the settlement's ordinary talk, and the parent tongues' recession are not selected.

C — PARALLEL BILINGUALISM: two full daily languages side by side at the hillfort, keyed to strand and situation, with practiced code-switching as ordinary adult competence, recognised interpreter-capable individuals as personal reputation rather than office, situational rather than stacked prestige, an imperial-script record anchor, and a remembered original-tongue script tradition surviving as scarce uneven memory-keeping in some locally rooted households. Not selected as displayed. Its parallel-bilingualism element contributes the older generation of the accepted combination; its remembered original-tongue script tradition is expressly amended out and is not established.
rationale: The generational split gives the settlement a sociolinguistic present that matches its founding frame: adults who carry two intact parent traditions still use both, while the first cohort raised inside the blend does what such a cohort does with two tongues at once. Keeping the mixing explicitly in progress and unnamed preserves the argument as live fiction rather than settling a language history, keeps both parent tongues alive as usable instruments, and leaves the widest later drafting space — stabilisation, recession, or nothing much — without a retcon. Anchoring literacy solely to the imperial script tradition holds WLD-LOCATION-004's ceiling and avoids inventing a second written tradition the story does not yet need.
evidence: Author multiple-choice selections on 2026-08-17 assembling an amended custom combination: Option C for the older generation, an Option-B-like hybridising development among the young held explicitly in progress and unnamed, Option C's remembered original-tongue script tradition amended out, and the option-independent shared claim set promoted as displayed.
consequences: Two distinct speech varieties are the region's principal ones: the tongue of the withdrawn imperial power and the original tongue, author-facing labels only, principal rather than exhaustive.

The hillfort's landscape is generationally split, with older-generation parallel bilingualism in both parent tongues keyed to strand and situation and practiced code-switching as ordinary adult competence.
The younger generation, raised with both tongues from childhood, is actively hybridising, mixing words from both tongues within a single sentence.

The hybridising speech is an in-progress generational development, not a settled or named third language; its carry, stabilisation, and any parent-tongue recession are explicitly open and argued within the fiction, and no generational outcome, language death, or future timeline is claimed.
Neither parent tongue is dying as fact, and no strand owns either tongue.

Literacy, where it exists, is anchored to the imperial script tradition, which holds the record function as a living skill descended from imperial practice, not from any intact archive; the original tongue is customarily unwritten, and no original-tongue script tradition, revival current, or written memory-keeping practice is established.
The outlet settlement is imperial-monolingual by default, so cross-lake dealings lean on hillfort speakers, a quiet standing asymmetry.

Recognised interpreter-capable individuals exist as personal competence and reputation only, never an office, never part of adjudication, creating no procedure, standing, entitlement, or right to be heard.

The shared claim set is also established: the imperial tongue owns the surviving written-record tradition as a living practice; comprehension between the settlements is ordinary with the direction of accommodation open; and uneven literacy is restated from WLD-CULTURE-001, not re-litigated.

Declared qualitative closure of the region's sociolinguistic structure — which varieties exist and how they are used — and that only; names, vocabularies, phonologies, grammars, and letterforms remain protected unknowns and no variety is named.

Declared qualitative closure of WLD-LOCATION-005's open language item: the outlet settlement's default everyday speech, and that only; internal speech composition, minority presence, and every other item that boundary lists stay open, and primarily still does not mean exclusively.

Declared bounded closure of WLD-HISTORY-001's open language item: a tongue of the withdrawn power survives in the region as a living speech variety, and its regional position, and that only; the power's name, that tongue's identity and script identity, its extent, its historical spread, and all its content stay open.
No further closure is declared; the hybridising speech is not established as a common institution of speech, and no other record's declared-open question is narrowed.

WLD-CULTURE-001's braid stands untouched: no strand dissolves and no strand dominates, household speech habits persist, and variety command and movement between tongues are fallible social readings only, never a System category, status scale, eligibility, or coming-of-age recognition.

WLD-CULTURE-002 keeps every compact term, office, ambiguity class, and open question; any concrete pairing of charter, oath, testimony, or record language with a variety is option-local illustrative material binding nothing and composing with every reading, and no oath text, written charter, or record accuracy is established.

The generational split is consistent with the settlement founding blend's early-stage hybridisation, which remains the sole authority for the founding frame; no founding-era fact and no founder, dynasty, or office-holder origin, strand, or speech is established here.

Tongue, variety, hybridising speech, register, and script tradition are author-facing qualitative labels fixing no in-world name, word, sound, grammar feature, letterform, sample utterance, institution, office, law, measurement, proportion, or performance guarantee.

No culture-frame content, rite or liturgical language, rite meaning, afterlife or Soul belief, medium inscription, contract language, or monetary vocabulary is established; the batch sibling records own those.
WLD-LOCATION-004's ceiling stands and no archive, school, curriculum, teaching institution, literacy-transmission custom, record content, or record accuracy is established.

Speech asymmetries and prestige postures colour WLD-EVENT-001's standing rivalry as tendencies only, with no incident, envoy, treaty, embargo, negotiation, trade language, market, price, or monetary fact; cross-lake dealings sit within the accepted travel bands and shore arrangement, which are not divided, extended, shortened, or recalculated, and no shore institution, schedule, worker role, or structure is created.
WLD-ECOLOGY-005's provenance discipline and WLD-HISTORY-001's presence classes continue to govern; no non-human language fact is established and the parked sapient pack species remains parked.

The landscape is author-side sociolinguistic truth as a pattern, not automatic character knowledge; standing pressures at story start are not occurred events, and no protagonist fact, character fact, speaker proportion, demographic figure, date, price, measurement, or occurred incident is established.
No new System mechanic, readout guarantee, eligibility, awakening modification, CAL0 change, or project-default adoption is created; the series-adopted WLD-PRENATAL-001A guardrail stands untouched.
residual_unknowns: All final names, vocabularies, phonologies, grammars, and any script's actual letterforms remain protected unknowns for a separate naming workflow.
Which tongue or tongues the System interface presents in, and for whom, remains deliberately unsettled under CAL0 UI1.0D presentation.
Whether the younger generation's hybridising speech stabilises, how far it carries, and whether either parent tongue recedes remain open and argued within the fiction.
Literacy transmission — who teaches reading, and whether any school, archive, or curriculum exists — remains open with no institution proposed.
Inter-settlement accommodation — who switches for whom in trade, and whether interpreter customs ever harden into anything institutional — remains open.

Dialect-level variation inside each tongue, whether the displaced-arrival and itinerant-craft or trade strands carry further varieties or trade-speech habits, and how far the outlet's imperial tongue has drifted from its historical parent remain open.
The speech of other basin communities, resident outsiders, and returning non-human peoples remains provenance-bounded and undeveloped.
How speech figures in the rites, the exchange media, and the three culture frames remains owned by the batch sibling records and open here.
reopening_conditions: Later accepted culture, rite, or exchange work cannot be voiced within a generationally split landscape of two parent tongues.
Later accepted work requires the young's hybridising speech to be already settled, named, or institutional, or requires either parent tongue to be dying as fact.
Later accepted literacy, archive, or institution work cannot sit on an imperial-script anchor with the original tongue customarily unwritten within WLD-LOCATION-004's ceiling.
Later accepted compact or adjudication work requires interpreter competence to be an office, a procedure, or an entitlement.
Later accepted outlet-settlement work cannot support an imperial-monolingual default within WLD-LOCATION-005's not-exclusively framing.
The Author explicitly chooses another sociolinguistic configuration.
